git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
perf-log: v3 schema — detector / actuator / timing tuning visibility

Pivots the perf-log channel from "prove the wire works" (v1/v2 integrity
story, complete) to "show what the algorithms are thinking." Schema v2 → v3
with three additions and one extension.

Wire format (perf_log_records.h):
- DETECTOR_CONFIG: cv_marvin_v1 sample coords, thresholds, and color
  filter weights — host needs these to render sample dots / threshold
  lines onto STRIP canvases at the correct pixel locations.
- ACTUATOR: per-Send intended/asserted masks, strum_dir, producer_id
  (the arbitration signal invisible from the wire byte alone), last CDC
  ack result + timestamp.
- TIMING extended from counts-only to a 35 B per-frame snapshot — chord
  window mask + age, note/strum queue head with deadlines, release
  timers, frets_active. Answers "why did it publish that mask at frame N."
- New PERF_TASK_IDLE + PERF_TASK_OTHER slots so per-window CPU% closes:
  IDLE registered via xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle; OTHER emits Σ all − Σ
  registered each runtime cycle.

Firmware producers:
- cv_marvin_v1 emits DETECTOR_CONFIG at task start + 1 Hz.
- timing_pipeline fills the snapshot per process_frame and emits TIMING.
- fretboard_link: Send(mask, producer_id) signature change; ACTUATOR
  per call; ack timestamp/result snapshotted in CDC WRITE_COMPLETE ISR.
- manual_control / timing_pipeline pass their producer IDs to Send.

MCC: FREERTOS_INCLUDE_XTASKGETIDLETASKHANDLE and
FREERTOS_INCLUDE_XTASKGETHANDLE enabled so the idle task and (future)
named MCC tasks can be registered with perf_log.

Host (marvin-perf): records.py / decode.py mirror; new DetectorConfig +
Actuator dataclasses; rewritten Timing; ActuatorProducer enum; IDLE +
OTHER TaskId values. EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3. Tests bumped with
new round-trip coverage for both new record types. 98/98 pass.

Out of scope this commit: web/api.py per-window CPU% endpoint
(cpu_pct: None placeholder still in place); viewer overlays for sample
dots / threshold lines on STRIP; actuator + timing detail panels.

Plan + rationale: firmware/marvin/docs/journal.md 2026-06-01 entry
"perf-log v3 plan: pivot to tuning visibility".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git status

static void F_USB_DEVICE_Tasks(  void *pvParameters  )

        vTaskDelay(10U / portTICK_PERIOD_MS);
    }
}

static void F_USB_HOST_Tasks(  void *pvParameters  )
{

        vTaskDelay(10U / portTICK_PERIOD_MS);
    }

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-06-01 17:52:11Z)**_

MCC per-task tracking added on top of v3:

**Firmware** ([`perf_log_records.h`](firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h)): `perf_task_id_t` extended with 9 new slots — `LEGATO=7`, `XLCDC=8`, `MAXTOUCH=9`, `SYS_INPUT=10`, `USB_DEVICE=11`, `USB_HOST=12`, `DRV_USB_UDPHS=13`, `DRV_USB_HOST=14`, `APP=15`; `OTHER` moved to 16. `PL_TASK_SLOT_COUNT = 17`.

**Firmware** ([`perf_log.c`](firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log.c)): `s_mcc_task_names[]` table maps each enum slot to the exact pcName MCC emits in [`tasks.c`](firmware/marvin/default/src/config/default/tasks.c). `register_mcc_tasks()` walks the table, calls `xTaskGetHandle`, registers any non-NULL handles. Called from `perf_log_drain_task` at startup — MCC tasks are created right before `vTaskStartScheduler` in `SYS_Tasks()`, so the lookup must happen post-scheduler. Missing names log a warning and fall through into OTHER instead of silently disappearing.

**Host** ([`records.py`](tools/marvin-perf/marvin_perf/records.py)): `TaskId` enum mirrored. 98/98 tests still pass — no test fixtures hard-coded numeric task_id values, all reference `TaskId.NAME`.

**Journal**: v3 entry's CPU accounting section updated — three additions (IDLE, MCC slots, OTHER) instead of two; OTHER now expected to idle near zero with everything named.

All on the work tree, ready to stage and commit when you are.

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
perf-log: v3 schema — detector / actuator / timing tuning visibility

Pivots the perf-log channel from "prove the wire works" (v1/v2 integrity
story, complete) to "show what the algorithms are thinking." Schema v2 → v3
with three new/extended record types and full per-task CPU accounting.

Wire format (perf_log_records.h):
- DETECTOR_CONFIG: cv_marvin_v1 sample coords, thresholds, color filter
  weights — host needs these to render sample dots / threshold lines onto
  STRIP canvases at correct pixel locations.
- ACTUATOR: per-Send intended/asserted masks, strum_dir, producer_id (the
  arbitration signal invisible from the wire byte alone), last CDC ack
  result + timestamp.
- TIMING extended from counts-only to a 35 B per-frame snapshot — chord
  window mask + age, note/strum queue head with deadlines, release timers,
  frets_active. Answers "why did it publish that mask at frame N."
- Task slots extended: PERF_TASK_IDLE (registered via
  xTaskGetIdleTaskHandle), 9 MCC slots (LEGATO, XLCDC, MAXTOUCH,
  SYS_INPUT, USB_DEVICE, USB_HOST, DRV_USB_UDPHS, DRV_USB_HOST, APP)
  resolved by string name with xTaskGetHandle from the perf-drain task
  at startup, and PERF_TASK_OTHER as the closure pseudo-slot. Per-window
  CPU% now adds to 100, with Legato (the largest MCC consumer) broken
  out for tuning.

Firmware producers:
- cv_marvin_v1 emits DETECTOR_CONFIG at task start + 1 Hz so a mid-stream
  host attach picks it up within a second.
- timing_pipeline fills the snapshot per process_frame and emits TIMING.
- fretboard_link: Send(mask, producer_id) signature change; ACTUATOR per
  call; ack timestamp/result snapshotted in CDC WRITE_COMPLETE ISR.
- manual_control / timing_pipeline pass their producer IDs to Send.

Host (marvin-perf): records.py / decode.py mirror; new DetectorConfig +
Actuator dataclasses; rewritten Timing; ActuatorProducer enum; expanded
TaskId enum. EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3. Tests bumped with new
round-trip coverage for both new record types. 98/98 pass.

Out of scope this commit: web/api.py per-window CPU% endpoint
(cpu_pct: None placeholder still in place); viewer overlays for sample
dots / threshold lines on STRIP; actuator + timing detail panels.

Plan + rationale: firmware/marvin/docs/journal.md 2026-06-01 entry
"perf-log v3 plan: pivot to tuning visibility".

Hardware verification pending — flash + capture not yet exercised.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git status
